quarterly_data.quarter: Pacific Biosciences press release: PacBio Announces Faster Runs, Up to 50% More HiFi Data, and (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: PacBio announced SPRQ-Nx chemistry and a software update for the benchtop Vega system, bringing Revio's core chemistry to Vega: HiFi output rises from 60 Gb to 90 Gb per run and the U.S. list price per run falls from $1,100 to $995, lowering cost per Gb by approximately 40%. The update adds two-hour and four-hour runs, a 5hmC caller and improved 5mC and 6mA callers, and user login and audit tracking for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance; DNA input drops from 2 µg to as low as 500 ng, and up to 96 samples can be multiplexed per run with PureTarget panels. In the first half of 2026, 19% of Vega runs used inserts shorter than 2 kb versus 3.6% of Revio runs. The chemistry is planned to ship, and the software to be available, by the end of the month.
quarterly_data.figure: Vega output 60 Gb to 90 Gb per run; list price per run $1,100 to $995; cost per Gb approximately 40% lower; planned to ship by the end of the month
